gen.title: Steps to work out change between index values
gen.orderNote: Follow the taught calculation order to find the change

steps.label: Express movements as percent changes
steps.quote: Movements of an index from one month to another are usually expressed as percent changes rather than as changes in the index value

steps.label: Subtract earlier value from later value
steps.quote: you first subtract the earlier index value from the later one

steps.label: Divide difference by earlier value
steps.quote: then divide that difference by the earlier index value

steps.label: Multiply result to get percent
steps.quote: and finally multiply the result by 100

steps.label: Check ratio multiplied for final change
